records.prompt:
Track registers 0..5, initially (85, 95, 77, 8, 12, 27). Execute the numbered operations in order. After each operation reduce every register modulo 97 to 0..96. add(i,j,n) adds n to register i (j is ignored). move(i,j,n) simultaneously subtracts n from i and adds n to j; insufficient balance is allowed. swap(i,j,n) swaps i and j (n is ignored). if_add(i,j,n) compares the pre-operation values: if register i > register j add n to i, otherwise add n to j.
1: swap(2,1,8)
2: swap(4,2,22)
3: move(2,4,18)
4: if_add(3,4,23)
5: add(1,4,30)
6: if_add(2,0,17)
7: swap(0,4,23)
8: add(2,3,38)
Return only {"state": [final register values in register order]}.
Solve carefully and return a complete answer in the task's required format.
